description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes Between Peoples Bank Vs. Ceylon Bank Employees Union, Elstcel  (Pvt.) Limited Vs. Inter Company Employee Union (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between People's Bank and Ceylon Bank Employees' Union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, and working conditions. The content represents a formal regulatory instrument published in accordance with statutory requirements (Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act), making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
